readOnly: Only workspace admins can change market and compliance settings. You can see what's in effect.
saveBlocked: Fix the highlighted field before saving

toast.audited: Recorded in the audit log with before and after values.

market.title: Market
market.description: Language is chosen by each person. The market is chosen once for the workspace: it sets the defaults for frameworks, AI provider, hosting and calendars.

global.label: Global
global.body: GRI, ISSB, ESRS and CDP first. Global AI provider and hosting.

cn.label: Mainland China
cn.body: SSE / SZSE / BSE exchange guidelines first, mainland AI provider, onshore hosting and 绿证 / CCER ledgers.

global.language: New people default to English until they pick a language
global.ai: AI drafting uses the global provider (Anthropic) unless you choose another
global.timezone: Deadlines are shown in UTC unless you set a timezone
global.calendar: The regulatory calendar highlights global and EU deadlines

cn.language: New people default to Simplified Chinese until they pick a language
cn.ai: AI drafting uses the mainland OpenAI-compatible provider (Qwen / DeepSeek) unless you choose another
cn.timezone: Deadlines are shown in Asia/Shanghai unless you set a timezone
cn.calendar: The regulatory calendar highlights exchange and HKEX deadlines

compliance.title: Hosting & compliance
compliance.description: What auditors and regulators will ask for: where the data lives, your ICP filing, the 等保 (MLPS 2.0) level and the cross-border transfer basis under PIPL.
compliance.mismatchTitle: Data residency is outside mainland China
compliance.mismatchBody: Mainland workspaces usually keep data onshore. If data leaves the mainland, make sure the cross-border transfer basis below is filed.

locale.title: Locale & reporting calendar
locale.description: Used for deadlines, amounts and the regulatory calendar. Empty fields use the market default.

residency.label: Data residency region
residency.hint: Where this workspace's data must be stored. Changing it does not move existing data.

icp.label: ICP filing number
icp.hint: ICP 备案号 or 经营许可证 number for the service domain, shown in the site footer.
icp.invalid: Use the official format, for example 京ICP备12345678号-1 or 沪ICP证123456号.

mlps.label: 等保 (MLPS 2.0) level
mlps.hint: The classified-protection level the system has been assessed at. SaaS that holds personal data is usually Level 3.

crossBorder.label: Cross-border data transfer
crossBorder.hint: The legal basis for any personal information leaving the mainland (PIPL art. 38 and the 2024 CAC provisions).

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.hint: Deadlines and the regulatory calendar count days in this zone.

currency.label: Reporting currency
currency.hint: Used for intensity metrics and financial denominators.

fiscalYearEnd.label: Fiscal year end
fiscalYearEnd.hint: Sets reporting-period defaults and filing deadlines.

venues.label: Listing venues
venues.hint: Exchanges where the company is listed. Drives which exchange guidelines and deadlines are highlighted.

audit.note: Every change is recorded in the audit log
